title: FlapLab Daily — We Will Not Forget Norway
story: You are the 2026 Nobel Peace Prize medal. Trump says he deserved you. Get to Navi Pillay in Oslo without being grabbed.
inspiration: Nobel Peace Prize to Navi Pillay (Oct 9, 2026); Trump: 'indelible stain on Norway… we will not forget' (NBC/BBC/Independent, Oct 9-10 2026). Medal + Trump portrait + Oslo City Hall from Wikimedia, rembg cutout.
